Hi Amit,

Congrats on your recent launch of Modify Video! I saw couple of Luma AI
people will be at CVPR so I wanted to see if you're heading to Nashville
too? If so, Ulrik is hosting a dinner Saturday evening (6/14) and would
love to catch up!

The evening will kick off with a fireside chat featuring Luc Vincent (Chief
R&D Officer at Nexar, former VP of AI at Meta) on his career & challenges
facing CV teams, followed by dinner joined by Adobe, Synthesia, Runway and
others.

Happy to share our latest product updates for Gen AI workflows, as well
learnings from a few video-native companies we've onboarded, e.g. Captions,
Archetype AI and Hudl.

Would be great to say hi at CVPR - let me know if you'll be there?

Best,
Winnie

--
